safety_limits: synthetic data and local source inspection only
no GitHub mutation, SQL/runtime connection, artifact access, deployment, or production operation
a reproduced model defect is not a product-runtime result or durable correction

cases.attack_or_failure: report evidence is revoked or config generation changes after dispatch, but completion still marks the artifact READY
cases.expected_result: completion must recheck current report, release/config fence and kill-switch state before publishing readiness
cases.evidence_to_pass: owner repair plus regression showing stale running work is fenced or quarantined

cases.attack_or_failure: caller self-asserts an arbitrary non-empty worker owner and epoch 999 without a controller-issued lease
cases.expected_result: dispatch must compare owner/run/epoch with an independently controlled current lease and reject self-assertion
cases.evidence_to_pass: controller-owned worker lease fixture with stale/foreign owner and epoch rejection

cases.attack_or_failure: path-like foreign artifact reference is accepted and exposed as READY
cases.expected_result: artifact identity must be server-derived, narrow, opaque and scoped; worker input cannot choose a path or namespace
cases.evidence_to_pass: server-owned artifact identity fixture and path/namespace injection rejection

cases.attack_or_failure: release generation increase permits config generation to regress from 4 to 1 because fences are compared lexicographically
cases.expected_result: independent generation axes must never regress silently; reviewed rollback needs an explicit fenced lineage
cases.evidence_to_pass: component-wise monotonic or explicit rollback-lineage tests

cases.attack_or_failure: the model has no cancel transition, cancelled state or kill-switch generation despite existing R2J-11 acceptance
cases.expected_result: cancel/kill-switch must durably fence queued and running workers and prevent READY publication
cases.evidence_to_pass: versioned cancellation and stale worker completion regression tests
